# International market practice

Region: Global. Sources verified 2026-10-11. Scope follows source documentation, not assumed nationwide CAMT availability.

## Country / regional references

### ASC X9 ISO20022 Market Practices Forum; resource hosted by EACT

**Role:** Informative remittance-data market guide author; EACT is European treasury-association host

**Reporting coverage:** RemittanceInformation hierarchy and usage for CAMT 052/053/054 alongside payment/remittance messages; not a full CAMT implementation guide.

**Messages / versions:** camt.052; camt.053; camt.054; pain.013; camt.028; remt; pain; pacs

- [ISO 20022 Remittance Content Market Guide, February 2022](https://eact.eu/Core/Images/EACT_PDFs/ISO-20022-Remittance-Content-Market-Guide-February-2022.pdf) — specification; public-file

Cover author is ASC X9, not EACT: ASC X9 IR 01-2022, first edition released 2022-02-14. Public 65-page PDF contains a 052/053/054 remittance hierarchy table and XML examples. It is not European regulation or a national profile. X9 retains all copyrights despite free availability.
